Brief is rendered by the command workflow, not the ladder
Cheapest change is a Purpose row in reply_format

label: The interactive /speckit:resume brief is not produced by the programmatic ladder: the command workflow carries its own continuity ladder (handover, then _memory.continuity, then spec docs) and its reply format fixes the fields at Confidence, Context source, Now, Last confirmed, Next safe action.

The programmatic ladder has exactly one non-test consumer, refreshAuthoredContinuitySnapshot (authored-continuity-snapshot.ts:201), which is imported only by Claude's opt-in compaction path, so a ResumeSignal change alone would not reach the operator-facing brief.

Correction to iteration 4: the cheapest closing change is a Purpose row in the resume workflow's reply_format plus the matching ladder-step instruction across the auto, confirm and presentation assets (three text files, no schema, no migration), since the workflow already reads spec.md.
Ruled out: parent-level acceptance criteria (no purpose column, 10 of 319 parents carry the file, four or more edit points to enable).
Ruled out: a parent-level user story or purpose section as a standalone change (the phase-parent template already carries it and the phase validator exempts parents, so no hop reads it).
Ruled out: an improved parent-specific template as the closing change (the template already carries the purpose; a template cannot supply a reader).
Ruled out: a purpose field in the continuity block as the cheapest option (most expensive, needs a fallback for 4657 existing summaries, leaves 29 handover-only packets uncovered).
Ruled out: the compaction brief as the primary carrier (feasible via lastSpecFolder in hook state, but covers one hop, needs per-runtime wiring and Claude's continuity path is opt-in).
Ruled out: relying on authors to restate purpose in handovers (0 of 97 have a Purpose heading; one restates an objective as an unparsed bullet).

Ruled out: using validation as the lever (the only executed required-anchor check exempts phase parents and the phase problem gate is never executed, so a validator change enforces authoring without crossing a hop).
